column7: resolveID returned the first list entry matching the requested secret name, so a server listing one name twice for the same project and environment had one of the two materialised arbitrarily (KFZ-2026-171, fuzz-corpus#176). A duplicate now fails with a plain error -- deliberately not ErrUpstreamGone, so the engine marks the target failed and retries rather than wiping the synced copy. The page walk that looks for the duplicate is capped at maxSecretListPages (TestFetcher_SecretListPageCountIsBounded); TestFetcher_SingleSecretMatchStillResolves is the liveness control pinning that a single match still resolves.
